21323-what-the-church-means-to-me-a-fran:
Wilfred T. Grenfell, the doctor and missionary famous for his medical mission in Labrador, published this frank confession in 1911. The church, he says, means all who are forwarding God's kingdom on earth, consciously or not. Any body that claims the title for itself alone, he calls ridiculous.

Through the church, Grenfell writes, came his spiritual sight, strength in weakness, comfort in trial, and help in need. He argues that how people organise worship gives no one a right to exclude others doing Christ's work another way. It is a short, warm statement from a practical Christian who spent his life running hospitals, ships, and schools in the North.
